r.정치 구도: A constitutional monarchy in which real power lies with parliament and a cabinet led by the prime minister. The 150 seats in the lower house are shared out in proportion to the national vote, so more than ten parties win seats and no single party ever gets a majority, which means governments are always coalitions. Immigration and asylum are the dominant issues: an anti-immigration party came first in the 2023 election, but the coalition it joined collapsed in 2025 over asylum policy. In the snap election of October 2025 the centrist-progressive D66 came first, and in February 2026 D66, the liberal VVD and the Christian Democratic CDA formed a minority coalition short of a majority in the lower house. It has to win opposition support bill by bill, and the housing shortage and limits on nitrogen emissions from farming are also major issues.

t.why: It sits where the Rhine and the Maas meet the sea, so the port of Rotterdam serves as the gateway for goods heading into continental Europe. It is home to ASML, the only company in the world that makes the extreme ultraviolet lithography machines used to print the most advanced chips, which made Dutch export controls central to US efforts to slow China's advanced chipmaking. In 2025 the government stepped into the management of Nexperia, a chipmaker owned by a Chinese company, sparking a clash with China that left European carmakers short of chips. The Hague hosts the International Court of Justice and the International Criminal Court, making it the stage for disputes between states and war crimes trials. It is a founding member of NATO and of the European Economic Community.
t.rel: A trading nation with Rotterdam, Europe's largest port. Home to the chip-equipment company ASML, it holds a key to export controls in the US-China technology race.
t.korea: Diplomatic relations were established in April 1961. During the Korean War it sent an army battalion and navy ships, with more than 5,000 troops serving in all, and the battalion commander was killed at the Battle of Hoengseong. Hendrick Hamel, a Dutch sailor shipwrecked on Jeju in 1653, spent 13 years in Joseon, and the account he wrote afterwards is regarded as the first detailed description of Korea for Western readers. Samsung Electronics and SK hynix are major buyers of ASML machines, and during the first state visit by a South Korean president in December 2023 the two countries agreed to greatly expand chip cooperation.
t.know: With about a quarter of the land below sea level, the Dutch have lived by building dikes and pumping out water.
etext: Re-export trade is huge: goods arrive through the port of Rotterdam and Schiphol airport and are sent on to Germany and the rest of continental Europe. As a result, a large share of its exports are goods imported from elsewhere and shipped out again.
The most advanced chips cannot be made without ASML's lithography machines. Chip and medical-device companies and research labs cluster around Eindhoven.

Though land is scarce, its expertise in greenhouse growing and plant breeding makes it the world's second-largest exporter of farm products after the United States. It is also known for its flower auctions and seed companies.

A severe housing shortage keeps home prices and rents high. The Groningen gas field was closed in 2024 because of earthquake damage caused by extraction, and rules forcing livestock farms to cut nitrogen emissions have set farmers against the government.
